title: Shrink Disputes Standing in Review and the Amount Withheld from a Tender
content:
A shrink dispute standing in review on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement holds part or all of the most recent shrink adjustment back from what the client tenders, and whether a shrink dispute has also been approved over the same half year settles how much.

## Conditions

**The whole of the most recent shrink adjustment posted on the agreement is withheld** where a shrink dispute on the agreement stands in review over the six months to the day the payment is taken, and the agreement also carries a shrink dispute approved over those six months.

**Half of the most recent shrink adjustment posted on the agreement is withheld**, taken to the nearest cent, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent, where a shrink dispute on the agreement stands in review over those six months, and the agreement carries no shrink dispute approved over those six months.

**Where no shrink dispute on the agreement stands in review over those six months**, nothing is withheld from the balance.

## The amount the withholding is measured on

Either condition is measured on the most recent shrink adjustment posted on the agreement, whatever its date, and not on the adjustments of the disputed period taken together.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying one shrink dispute in review and one approved over the half year, whose most recent shrink adjustment was 310.00 USD, withholds 310.00 USD from the balance. Had no shrink dispute been approved over that half year, 155.00 USD would be withheld. With nothing in review, neither condition is reached.
